notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Squirrel, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.
